label: Netanyahu in the eye of a storm, with voices demanding he be removed
description: Netanyahu seen inside a hurricane with a storm on all sides, voices in the storm saying he must be removed and repeating the words war crimes. Distinct from the September arrest-threat claim: this is his removal from office rather than his arrest abroad.

label: Trump seen about fifty pounds lighter
description: In visions of the days ahead the president looks skinnier in the face, like he lost fifty pounds, still with a pep in his step. Repeated across several tellings and treated by him as evidence the prayers are working.
aliases: he looked like he lost 50 lbs

label: Canada and Mexico merge financially with America, keeping their borders
description: After a great financial shaking Canada joins America financially, becoming the 51st state in money only: physical borders remain but there are no financial borders and no separate Canadian dollar. Mexico, then Australia and Europe, join the same bloc to counter BRICS.

label: The February 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy singled out as serious
description: The Olympics in February 2026 in Italy highlighted as something serious to pray over, with the content withheld and more of the puzzle promised later. A dated and located warning with no stated event.

label: The German chancellor looking both ways between America and BRICS
description: Germany seen double-minded, looking toward the western bloc and toward BRICS at the same time, with its leader weighing which way to go. Given while the rest of Europe is described as joining the American side.
aliases: which way do we want to go

label: Kim Jong-un eventually removed, and his sister with him
description: He states his own belief that Kim Jong-un will eventually be removed, and his sister as well. Marked as belief rather than as something shown, and with no window, so it cannot expire on his terms.

label: Putin holding five cards, hiding behind them
description: Putin seen with North Korea behind him and Xi Jinping with his allies, holding five cards fanned out and hiding behind them, with World War III in black letters seen before it. The number five is given without content.
aliases: holding them out like a fan
World War III in black letters

label: Drill baby drill, and great oil coming in the Gulf
description: Oil derricks pumping, great oil seen in the Gulf and great oil coming in America, set inside the blessing that follows America lining up with Israel.

label: A Black senator who ran before, whose voice grows louder
description: Three Democratic voices seen rising together: the California governor, Kamala Harris, and a man he identifies hesitantly as Booker, who ran for president before and whose voice tries to become louder in the days ahead. He is unsure of the name.

label: The California governor turning his back on trafficking across the border
description: The governor seen knowingly allowing people to be trafficked and drugs smuggled across the border, with great demonic things to be discovered and uncovered, leading to embarrassing moments and his removal. An accusation against a named living person carried on the vision alone.
aliases: turning his back to it like he knew

label: Inflation is worse than the published numbers
description: Inflation and conditions stated to be worse than what they are saying, with the economy kept afloat artificially and a paddled canoe as the image. A standing claim of this genre that costs nothing to make.
aliases: worse than what they are saying

label: In the 2027 and 2028 visions the United States did not exist as it does
description: Looking into the fall of 2027 into 2028 he says it looked so heavy that the United States did not exist the way he saw it, tied to the Texas secession and Oklahoma division material. He attaches the prayer condition to this one.
aliases: didn't exist like I saw it

label: A changing of judges in the days ahead
description: A changing of judges repeated three times as something to hear and pray into, tied to federal harassment and to the scouts having to get involved. Distinct from the three obstructing judges claim, which is about roadblocks rather than turnover.
